name: Build, correct, and retain a whole observation
description: A correct whole can be recorded as practice and corrected without generating independent evidence.
steps: Add one half twice, then Check arrangement
Correct the new Learning notes observation to Try again
Use Show archived notes, restore the observation, then select Show current notes
expected: Learning notes retains Try again for Build one whole. No independent challenge completion is reported. Archiving hides the observation, and Restore returns it with the corrected outcome.

name: Equivalent demonstration preserves the learner arrangement
description: Two quarters match a half and the demonstration never fills the answer on the learner's behalf.
steps: Verify the total remains 1 / 4 and the demo describes 1/4 + 1/4 = 1 / 2
Check arrangement and verify more space remains
Add another quarter and Check arrangement
expected: Two quarters were accepted as a half. Start again leaves an empty arrangement with total 0 / 1.

name: Independent challenge and note export on mobile
description: An unassisted correct challenge records evidence and can be exported locally.
steps: Add one quarter three times and Check arrangement
Verify Build two thirds is shown and guidance is hidden
expected: A JSON notes download is offered and the independent Build three quarters observation persists. The interface has no horizontal overflow.

name: Hints cannot be hidden to manufacture independent evidence
description: Assistance remains attached to an attempt even after guidance is hidden.
steps: Add one quarter three times and Check arrangement
Verify Independent remains disabled and record With help
Add another quarter and Check arrangement
Remove the fourth piece using its remove button and check again
expected: The corrected arrangement matches but independent recording remains disabled. Learning notes labels the saved attempt Assisted challenge.
